approach.name: One-pass hash map (value -> index) with complement lookup
approach.description: Loop through nums; at each element, first check whether target minus the current value is already in the map (value -> index), then store the current value with its index. On a hit, return the stored index and the current index. Check happens before insert, so an element cannot pair with itself. Cost described as one lookup and one insert per element, and the map grows by one entry per element.

opening: Hi, I'm LeetUP. I'll help you think through the problem.

turns.learner: Hash map. Loop through, store each number's index, and check if target minus current is already in the map. It's faster than brute force.
